instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Titan Networks provides critical energy management solutions for commercial and industrial facilities, focusing on optimizing HVAC systems and reducing operational waste through data analytics. The company has successfully deployed complex monitoring solutions across various sectors like healthcare and manufacturing, establishing a strong service footprint.
answers.pastInitiatives: The recent launch of the AI-powered recommendation engine significantly accelerated market penetration and established a new high-margin revenue stream. This initiative demonstrated successful internal scalability and validated the company's ability to integrate cutting-edge digital tools into existing service delivery models.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate, requiring us to rapidly expand our market share by becoming a recognized leader in smart building technology. We are willing to make significant strategic bets, potentially including M&A or disruptive product lines, provided they offer clear paths to substantial revenue within 18 months.
answers.additionalContext: Upcoming changes to industry-specific safety and certification standards will require us to recertify our entire product line over the next 2 years. The recertification process is expensive and time-consuming. We need innovation ideas that either accelerate the recertification workflow itself or deliver sufficient business value to justify the combined certification-plus-innovation investment.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: Smart Recertification Workflow Integration (Value Driver)
opportunities.rationale: Given the upcoming regulatory challenges and high cost of recertification, developing an automated module that integrates compliance data directly into the monitoring platform could turn a major operational burden into a unique selling proposition.

first_actions: Identify core compliance data points needed for recertification
Pilot AI-driven compliance reporting feature in Q3
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average client certification time by 20%
milestones: Q4: Pilot launch with 3 anchor clients

opportunities.title: Acquire Niche Energy Storage/Grid Tech Startup
opportunities.rationale: To achieve rapid growth and bypass slow internal development cycles, a bold move is to acquire a small, specialized startup focused on next-generation battery or grid stabilization technology. This provides immediate market entry into high-growth segments.

first_actions: Conduct due diligence on 3 target startups
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful integration of acquired technology leading to $2M ARR within 18 months
milestones: Month 1-3: Target identified and LOI signed
Month 6: Acquisition closed and integration plan finalized

next_steps.action: Launch a rapid feasibility study on the 'Smart Recertification Workflow Integration' project to validate ROI.
Develop an M&A pipeline and create a formal strategic playbook for acquisitions aligned with growth goals.

key_weaknesses: Siloed organizational structure hindering cross-departmental innovation flow.
Budget constraint (28%) limiting the scale and speed of radical experimentation required for rapid growth.
Formal innovation process potentially slowing down necessary 'bold' or fast incremental pivots.
